//: Type-check configuration for the harness's own TypeScript.
Run it through ./scripts/typecheck.sh, which supplies the one thing
that cannot be committed: where @thurstonsand/pi-permissions and
@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent happen to live on this machine.
Nothing is ever emitted; Pi's loader strips types at load time.
permissions/lib/*.js is resolved but not checked (checkJs false):
the matchers are plain JavaScript, exercised directly by the test
suite through Node rather than through the type system.
allowImportingTsExtensions is on because Pi's loader (and this repo's
own tests, via node --experimental-strip-types) resolve local imports
by their literal .ts extension, with no build step to rewrite them to
.js. It requires noEmit or emitDeclarationOnly, both satisfied here.
